blurb: Australia's oldest and most visited art museum, founded in 1861.

facts.t: Giambattista Tiepolo's Banquet of Cleopatra, painted around 1743 to 1744, shows a story Pliny told, probably a legend: Cleopatra won a bet by dissolving a pearl in vinegar and drinking it. Catherine the Great once owned it; the Soviet government sold it to Melbourne in 1932.
